title: Head Trajectories of a Counter Loop
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ and $amma$ be types with decidable equality, let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an injection, let $M$ be a $k$-tape Turing machine, and let $ain S$ and $\mathrm{exit}:\mathrm{Option}(S)$. Let $R$ be a round contract for $M$ with anchor $a$ and escape set $\{\mathrm{exit}\}$, and fix an input $x$. For $p=(i,w)$ and a configuration $d$ of the counter-loop machine, suppose the last tape of $d$ stores the encoded word $w$ at offsets $q$ for $-1\le q\le |w|$, as specified by the buffer convention, and that every round with index $r< v(w)$, starting from the body configuration associated with $d$, satisfies $R$'s precondition and has an endpoint in state $a$. Then for every time $q$ up to the counter-loop contract's prescribed duration, there exist $r$ and $u$ such that either $r<v(w)$ and $u$ is at most the duration of round $r$, or $r=v(w)$ and $u=0$, and the first $k$ work-tape head positions at time $q$ equal those of the run of $M$ from the start of round $r$ at time $u$.

replaced:
Let $k$ be a natural number, let $\Gamma$ and $S$ be types with decidable equality, let
$e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an injection, and let $M$
be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, anchor state $a$, and escape state
$\mathrm{exit}$. Let $R$ be a round contract for $M$ with anchor $a$ and escape set
$\{\mathrm{exit}\}$. For a parameter $p=(i,w)$, write $v(w)$ for the base-two value of
the Boolean word $w$, and let $d$ be a configuration of the counter-loop machine whose
state is the counter-decrement running phase. Assume that, on the last tape, the cells
from the head position through the next $|w|-1$ cells encode $w$ via $e$ (with the
specified blank-buffer convention), and that for every $r<v(w)$ the $r$th round of $M$,
starting from the body configuration associated with $d$, satisfies $R$'s precondition
and returns to state $a$. Then at every time $q$ up to the counter-loop contract's
prescribed duration, there exist natural numbers $r,u$ such that either $r<v(w)$ and $u$
is at most the duration of that round, or $r=v(w)$ and $u=0$, and the first $k$
work-tape head positions at time $q$ equal those in the run of $M$ from the start of
round $r$ at time $u$.
